messages:
Maria M.: FYI launch posts + webinar went live this AM. Dashboard shows a big lead bump but attribution is weirdly tilted to direct. Can folks check UTMs?
Prateek: Jumping in 1. Dash snapshot: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/launch-ops. Looks like ~40-50% of new leads have null utm_source.
Olivia (DS): analytics-bot flagged GA4 export lag at 09:12. Pulling sample rows now.
analytics-bot: [alert] GA4 export latency increased for property project-redwood-web at 09:15 (x2.8). Backfill scheduled.
Jamal: Quick ops note: I pushed a caching redirect last week for /r/launch -> canonical that does a 301. Might be stripping querystrings on some clients.
Maria M.: That redirect was meant to be query-preserving. Jamal can you confirm the nginx config?
Jamal: Found it. There was a `return 301 https://redwood.ai$uri;` pattern that drops $args. Rolling a canary rollback to preserve queries.
Prateek: If UTMs are gone our attribution logic falls back to direct in Looker. We'll get an artificial direct spike. Flag this for the KPI review tomorrow.
Olivia (DS): Sample rows show page_location without query on a subset: 
``nuser_id: u_9b2
page_location: https://redwood.ai/launch-posts
utm_source: null
referrer: https://t.co/abc123
```
Cohort analysis in progress.
Maria M.: Prioritize: 1) small canary rollback, 2) re-ingest/backfill GA4, 3) slide for KPI deck showing before/after attr split + impact on MQL rate.
Jamal: Canary to 5% at 09:28. Monitoring for errors and conversion delta.
analytics-bot: [info] Backfill job queued (bf-2026-03-23-09-31).
Olivia (DS): Quick pivot: UTMs present (n=420) MQL rate 8.3% | UTMs missing (n=380) MQL rate 6.0%. There's a quality delta.
Prateek: Good to have numbers. For tomorrow's weekly KPI review let's surface both raw leads and normalized leads after backfill so execs see the noise.
Maria M.: Also we should add a short mitigation: require redirect tests in staging + an automated check that redirects preserve querystrings.
Jamal: Canary stable for 6m, moving to 25% now. Will revert if any error spike.
Prateek: I'll add an alert in analytics: trigger if >15% of launch traffic has missing utm params.
Olivia (DS): After backfill we'll re-run the cohort and publish an updated slide. Posting updated pivot when available.
Maria M.: Thanks team. I'll draft the KPI annotation and include the MQL comparison and ops timeline. Keep this thread updated. :thumbsup:
